copy.headline: Macy's parade delay leaves North Texas performers scrambling to stay
copy.caption:
WATCH: Macy's parade delay leaves North Texas performers scrambling to stay

Hundreds of North Texas dancers face extra hotel and flight costs after Macy's moved its parade to Saturday.

Video: WFAA on YouTube

story.title: Macy's parade delay leaves North Texas performers scrambling to stay
story.summary: Hundreds of North Texas dancers face extra hotel and flight costs after Macy's moved its parade to Saturday. Some teams are even driving home.
